newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Notes stolen from Sierra Leone central bank.
newsitem.headline: Notes stolen from Sierra Leone central bank.

text.p: Large sums in old banknotes have been stolen from Sierra Leone's central bank, governor Steve Swaray said on Friday.

Two newspapers reported on Friday that 100 million leones ($105,000) had gone missing from the Bank of Sierra Leone despite the recent installation of security cameras, but Swaray declined to say exactly how much had gone missing.
"I cannot disclose the missing amount now as a cash count is presently in progress at the bank. More money may be discovered missing," Swaray told Reuters.
He said the loss was discovered about two weeks ago during a routine check and the missing money was old banknotes, many of which were intended for destruction.
Swaray said 11 bank officials had been sacked for theft and an inquiry had been launched in the West African country.
